props.name: className

props.name: nativeButton
props.description:
Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it
via the `render` prop.
Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Collapsible.Trigger.State) => ReactElement) | ((props: HTMLProps, state: CollapsibleTriggerState) => ReactElement) | undefined
